 SHOPEE CUP™ GROUP B: CÔNG AN HÀ NỘI FC 1-3 JDT FC 
 Nov 19 2026
 -->
 -->
 Óscar Arribas scored twice as Johor Darul Ta’zim FC battled back from conceding an early own goal to hand Công An Hà Nội FC a 3-1 defeat in Hanoi on Thursday as Xisco Muñoz’s side maintained their perfect start to Group B of the ASEAN Club Championship Shopee Cup™ .
 Nené had put the ball in his own net in the fourth minute but Arribas scored in the 50th and 85th  minutes, with Marcos Guilherme netting on the hour mark as the Malaysia Super League outfit picked up their second win in a row in the 2026/27 campaign.
 The home side had taken an early lead when the pressure applied by Alan Grafite and Brayan Perea paid off handsomely for Mano Pölking’s side.
 Alan played the ball into the JDT penalty area to Perea and, while the Brazilian striker was surrounded by defenders, the uncertainty at the back resulted in Portuguese defender Nené bundling the ball over his own goal line.
 Alan almost doubled that advantage in the 15th minute with a long-range effort that left Andoni Zubiaurre flat-footed in the JDT goal but the ball rebounded off the post and was eventually cleared.
 Cao Pendant Quang Vinh’s through ball set up Alan for another strike on goal five minutes later but the Brazilian sliced his shot wide. Seconds later, Damià Sabater should have done better than present Zubiaurre with a simple save from close range.
 Công An Hà Nội continued to dominate as the half-hour mark approach with Perea’s right-foot strike from 25 yards out beating Zubiaurre only for the ball to clip the outside of the goalkeeper’s right post and bounce wide.
 The V.League 1 champions were only able to retain their lead for five minutes of the second half as the Malaysian side pulled level in style. 
 The ball was worked to the left angle of the penalty area by Afiq Fazail, from where Arribas bent a delightful right-foot strike into the top corner with Filip Nguyen given little chance.
 Ten minutes later the Malaysians went ahead. Jairo raced onto a long ball from out of defence, laying possession into the path of Guilherme and he steered his shot from the edge of the penalty area into the corner with minimal fuss.
 Alan was inches away from levelling with seven minutes remaining when his low shot from 15 yards out clipped the left post with the sprawling Zubiaurre beaten but two minutes later, JDT put the seal on the win.
 Guilherme picked up the ball deep inside the home half before feeding the fast-arriving Arribas and he stroked his shot in for the crucial third.
 Shopee Star of the Match - Marcos Guilherme (#95), Johor Darul Ta'zim FC
